name: NTE Host-Engine IPC Protocol Specification
description: Standardized binary framing, JSON envelope, ring-buffer data plane, sequence scopes, and command idempotency specification between .NET Native Host and Python Intelligence Engine.

versionPolicy.rule: During V2 strangler migration, exact protocolVersion '1.0.0' equality is enforced across Host and Engine.

sequenceScope.description: Host and Engine independently track monotonically increasing sequence counters per sender within the current session. Inbound messages with sequence <= lastHighWaterMark are detected as stale.

rules: If incoming command matches an active or completed (sessionId, commandId) with identical payload, return cached COMMAND_RESULT without re-execution.
If incoming command matches (sessionId, commandId) with differing action or parameters, reject fail-closed with ERR_COMMAND_ID_REUSE_MISMATCH.
If monotonicTimestampNs > expiresAtNs, reject with status EXPIRED.

controlPlane.framing: 4-byte little-endian uint32 payload length prefix followed by UTF-8 encoded JSON payload; for stdio stream fallback, newline-delimited JSON is supported

zeroCopy.clarificationNote: Physical virtual address mapping is zero-copy between processes; GPU-to-CPU texture readback involves D3D11 staging copy.
